text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged down to 48.56 percent from 51.10 percent at the last sale on December 6, the central bank said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 10.00 million UAH 7.34 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.92 million UAH 6.51 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,000 T-bills. Of those, 18,880 were competitive and 81,120 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 12.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 58.42 percent from 59.80 percent at the last sale on December 6.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 6.48 million UAH 35.07 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.02 million UAH 27.02 million UAH
The central bank sold 64,819 T-bills. Of those, 39,668 were competitive and 25,151 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 12.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 60.86 percent from 58.51 percent at the last sale on December 6.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 1.34 million UAH 216,330 UAH
The central bank sold 19,501 T-bills. Of those, 18,465 were competitive and 1,036 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 12.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills was unchanged at 61.20 percent, the same as at the last sale on December 6.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 4,702 T-bills. Of those, 3,817 were competitive and 885 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 12.
